flaws.why_wrong: GRT does not produce DRCs, it produces overflow/congestion violations. DRC implies detailed routing ran. Record itself admits no post-fix DRC count, so pre-fix should also be called overflow.
flaws.correct_version: GRT reported ~20k overflow/congestion violations, visualized in GUI via run-me-BoomTile-asap7-base.sh gui

flaws.claim: 0.24 placement density with a lot of open space especially at top, yet congestion heatmap shows large region at top
flaws.why_wrong: Low global density and 'open space at top' directly contradicts 'large congestion at top'. If top is empty of cells, top congestion cannot be cell-density driven. Requires macro-induced routing detour explanation.
flaws.correct_version: Global placement density 0.24 (definition of density metric not given). Open placement at top of die but GRT congestion hotspot also at top and around macro, suggesting congestion is routing-demand/macro-blockage driven, not cell-density driven.

flaws.claim: GRT routing-layer adjustment of 0.45 is too aggressive, fix by reducing to 0.2
flaws.why_wrong: Record states in gaps that exact meaning of high vs low value is only explained in prose and not captured. If adjustment is fraction KEPT, 0.45->0.2 is MORE aggressive (45%->20% capacity). If adjustment is fraction REDUCED/BLOCKED, 0.45->0.2 is LESS aggressive. Claim asserts fix without defining semantics.
flaws.correct_version: Adjustment parameter semantics must be stated per set-global-routing-layer-adjustment docs. Under [keep vs reduce] definition, 0.45->0.2 means [decrease/increase] of available tracks from X to Y. Thread reports local workaround of changing value to 0.2 allowed GRT to finish.

flaws.claim: Two root causes listed as one: layer adjustment too aggressive AND global-route path looping around macro many times (#5971)
flaws.why_wrong: If looping bug is true, layer adjustment is a workaround that masks bug by adding capacity, not a root cause. If layer tuning is true, loop is irrelevant. Record defers loop to #5971 unresolved, cannot claim both.
flaws.correct_version: Two separate hypotheses tracked: H1 tuning: asap7 layer adjustment 0.45 over-constrains this design; H2 bug: GRT path looping around macro (see #5971). No disambiguation or ablation in this thread.

flaws.claim: Increasing congestion iterations from default 30 to 35 fixes 20k violations
flaws.why_wrong: 16% increase in iterations cannot plausibly resolve 20k overflow alone. Intervention bundles two changes (adjustment + iterations) with no isolated test. Candidates list duplicates same change.
flaws.correct_version: Thread swept overflow/congestion iteration count (default 30). Final reported workaround bundled adjustment 0.45->0.2 plus iterations 30->35. No ablation to separate effects.

flaws.claim: GRT was reported to complete after change, confidence 0.8
flaws.why_wrong: Post_state admits 'No re-measured DRC count was given' and quote is 'could finish GRT'. No logs, no overflow count, no runtime. Issue was closed automatically as not_planned/Stale in 2026 with no PR link and unknown if change merged. High confidence inconsistent with gaps.
flaws.correct_version: Anecdotal report by MEMBER eder-matheus on 2024-11-14 that GRT could finish with 0.2/35 settings. No measured post-fix overflow, no runtime, no merged config change, issue auto-closed stale/not_planned, fix status unknown. Confidence should be low.

flaws.why_wrong: Density definition not given: global vs average bin density, inclusive/exclusive of macros, with/without whitespace. Single number meaningless without method.
flaws.correct_version: Reported global placement density 0.24 (method unspecified, presumably ORFS global placement), in asap7 with given ORFS version tag.

corrected_record.title: BoomTile/asap7: ~20k GRT overflow violations at reported 0.24 placement density, workaround via layer adjustment
corrected_record.prior_state: BoomTile (Megaboom-derived) in asap7, ORFS v3.0-1735-gdefc349e. Reported placement density 0.24 with open space at top of die, but design failed GRT.
corrected_record.observation: GRT reported ~20k overflow/congestion violations. Congestion heatmap via run-me-BoomTile-asap7-base.sh gui shows hotspots at top of die and around macro despite low cell density, suggesting macro-blockage/routing-demand cause.
corrected_record.hypothesis: H1: GRT layer adjustment 0.45 tuned for other asap7 designs over-constrains BoomTile. H2 (separate, #5971): GRT paths looping many times around macro.
corrected_record.candidates_considered: Sweep overflow/congestion iterations from default 30; relax layer adjustment 0.45->0.2; raise iterations to 35; macro placement improvement per #5971.
corrected_record.chosen_intervention: Local workaround per eder-matheus (MEMBER, 2024-11-14): set layer adjustment to 0.2 (semantics per set-global-routing-layer-adjustment doc need to be defined as keep vs reduce) and congestion iterations to 35, reported to allow GRT to finish. Bundled change, no ablation.
corrected_record.post_state: Anecdotal completion only: 'could finish GRT' / 'complete BoomTile'. No post-fix overflow count, runtime, or logs. No PR linked. Issue auto-closed as not_planned/Stale in 2026, merge status unknown.
